messages:
david: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

— Did: got the synthia-v2 prompt-set onboarded into eval harness, fixed tokenizer edge for spanish dates. Ran overnight sample (5k) and pushed results to /mnt/evals/synthia-v2/2026-03-17

— Blockers: seeing a weird stutter in top-1 accuracy on longctx (>4k) when kv-cache warmup is hit. looks like a batching artifact, not model quality. need infra traces.

— Today: triage kv-batching logs with infra, open a small reproducer, request quick CR for the patch that adds a small delay in kv warmup path. pinging @infra.

asha: thanks david — can you drop the reproducer command here when you have it? I can run local traces on my devbox.

leo: I skimmed the overnight outputs — prompt-set looks solid except a spike in 'politeness' metric for a subset of Spanish conversational tests. likely tokenization. good catch on dates.

sophia: tagging QA — rachel can you put a quick smoke check on synthia-v2 PR? should be <15m: `pytest tests/evals/test_synthia_smoke.py::test_spanish_dates -k quick`

rachel: on it, starting now. if CI flakes I'll post logs.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: synthia-v2-eval-run -> staging at 2026-03-17T22:10:00Z (triggered by david) :rocket:

david: reproducer (local):
```
python -m scripts/run_eval.py --model synthia-v2 --promptset prompts/spanish_dates.json --seed 42 --max-tokens 4096 --batch-size 8 --kv-warmup 1
```
This triggers the stutter in ~30-40% of runs locally.

leo: thanks — running that now. if it's a warmup edge we might see correlation with batch-size; try `--batch-size 4` and `--kv-warmup 0` as quick checks.

asha: also please attach the trace id when you see it: `export TRACE_OUT=/tmp/trace.json && TRACE_LOG=1` before running. infra can ingest.

rachel: smoke done — small flaky test failing on unrelated torch device allocation, re-run CI. will comment on PR in 10.

david: created minimal PR with two-line throttling insertion to smooth early kv fills: https://github.com/redwood-inference/synthia/commit/abc1234 — requesting review from @leo @asha. It's marked WIP until we confirm traces.

leo: quick review done — lgtm w/ one nit (inline comment). no objections to merge after CI.

asha: if infra traces confirm this is a scheduling artifact, we should add a test that exercises the warmup path under concurrent batches. I can draft tomorrow.

david: sounds good. blocker: waiting on traces and QA green. if both clear I'll merge and schedule a canary rollout to dedicated pool.

sophia: can we also add a dashboard tile for 'kv-warmup latency' in console? this would have alerted earlier. adding ticket: CON-834.

leo: pinging infra: @infra — any ETA on trace availability for the run I started?

infra: trace collected: id=trace-20260317-9876, uploaded to /traces/trace-20260317-9876.json. noted scheduling jitter at step 12.

david: receiving it now, will analyze and post a short snippet.

david: quick snippet from trace shows 200ms gap between batch dispatch and kv-fill step when concurrency spikes — aligns with warmup theory.

rachel: CI passing on re-run; leaving one minor comment in PR.

leo: if CI stays green and infra confirms, let's do canary tomorrow morning 08:00 UTC to the small-llama-pool. I can watch metrics.

sophia: +1. david, please add canary playbook notes (rollback steps, flags) in PR description.

david: will add playbook and rollout flags. thanks everyone — I'll post an update here once merged and canary scheduled. :thumbsup:
__notes: single-string thread, messages in chronological order
